description: Once the person says they’re done adding their pages at the address add_fax_file_link gave, answers the documents it put on their draft, ready to send, with their pages. Until they’ve pressed “Done adding pages” there, added is false, there are no documents, and ask says what to ask of them: to add their pages there, press “Done adding pages”, and tell you when they’re done; then call again. Give send_fax their ids, with any others you added, in the order you added them.

link_id.description: The link, as add_fax_file_link gave it.

name: finish_fax_file_link

added.description: Whether the person has added their files at the address, and XipFax has read them.

ask.description: While added is false: what to ask of the person before you call again.

documents.description: The documents the link put on the draft, in their order: none until it has.

name.description: Its name, as it was added.

page_count.description: Its pages, once XipFax has read it; null while it uploads.

status.description: `uploading` until XipFax has read it back, then `ready`. An open set: read what you know.
